title: Tired of one-nighters and the World's Greatest Jazz Band
summary: They discuss the one-nighter tours that wore him down and the band's need for a steady gig.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, they were sort of still doing the kind of tours that you don't really get much any more unless you're in a big band.
Right. We did a whole lot of one-nighters, and that got me down.
That was kind of a nice band for a while.
Yeah, it was. I enjoyed it. I had a ball with that band.
Now they're sort of down to just picking up a (?)...
Yes. I guess they'll get together if they get a steady gig for a awhile. They need to work somewhere steady, and then get themselves established again. They have some good guys.
